info.name: AB Tasty Decision Activate Environments API

params.name: environmentId
params.description: Identifies your account and environment (preprod or prod)

params.name: mode
params.description: Specifies the format of the response body

items.docs:
Retrieves all the campaigns that correspond to the specified user and context attributes.
By default, the API will send a CAMPAIGN hit to Flagship for each campaign in the response.
